diff --git a/CHANGELOG.md b/CHANGELOG.md
index b651f66b..70122071 100644
--- a/CHANGELOG.md
+++ b/CHANGELOG.md
@@ -7,10 +7,16 @@ For the full commit history, see the git log.
 
 ## Unreleased
 
-## v6.1110.5 — 2026-11-10
+## v6.1110.6 — 2026-11-10
 
 - **Stabilize Sumi focus writing on Linux.** Fix fractional scroll feedback that made the text jump between adjacent pixels. Hide the native editor scrollbar and frame while preserving scrolling and the input position outside focus mode.
 
+- **Restore mouse input in the Sumi Linux editor.** Make the focus decoration’s own GTK window transparent to input so clicks, text selection and mouse-wheel scrolling reach the native body.
+
+## v6.1110.5 — 2026-11-10
+
+Unpublished validation build. Its focus-writing fix is included in v6.1110.6; this build failed the native mouse-input release gate.
+
 ## v6.1110.4 — 2026-11-10
 
 - **Omarchy plugin windows and shortcuts.** Linux plugin windows open with a movable title bar, resize controls and an initial size fitted to the available desktop. App commands use Ctrl; Sumi uses F11 for fullscreen and keeps its controls reachable above the desktop dock. Fullscreen writing uses one proportional font scale and restores the saved size on exit.
diff --git a/CHANGELOG.zh-CN.md b/CHANGELOG.zh-CN.md

@@ -6,10 +6,16 @@
 
 ## 未发布
 
-## v6.1110.5 — 2026-11-10
+## v6.1110.6 — 2026-11-10
 
 - **修复 Sumi Linux 聚焦书写抖动。** 消除居中计算的半像素滚动回授，让正文和候选保持稳定；隐藏原生正文滚动条及边框，保留正常滚动和非聚焦原位输入。
 
+- **恢复 Sumi Linux 原生正文鼠标操作。** 让焦点装饰层自身的 GTK 窗口穿透输入，正文点击定位、拖选和滚轮不再被装饰层截获。
+
+## v6.1110.5 — 2026-11-10
+
+未公开的验收构建。聚焦修复随 v6.1110.6 交付；此构建未通过原生正文鼠标输入发布门禁。
+
 ## v6.1110.4 — 2026-11-10
 
 - **调整 Omarchy 插件窗口与快捷键。** Linux 插件窗口恢复可拖动标题栏和缩放，启动尺寸适配可用桌面。应用命令统一使用 Ctrl，Sumi 以 F11 切换全屏，工具区避开桌面 Dock；全屏书写按单一比例调整字号，退出后恢复保存的字号。
